description: This file defines the Api class for interacting with Confluence via HTTP requests, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, deleting pages, and handling attachments, with error handling and source code display features.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with Confluence API, including page retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and attachment management, with error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Api class with base URL, username, and password.

methods.name: setSpace
methods.description: Sets the space ID for subsequent API operations.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a Guzzle HTTP client configured with base URI and authentication.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Processes BadResponseException to generate more informative error messages and handle specific cases like duplicate titles.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Retrieves a page by ID, including its content, title, version, and ancestor info.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of pages under a root page, optionally recursively.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Creates a new page under a specified parent with given title and content.

methods.name: updatePage
methods.description: Updates an existing page with new content and version number.

methods.name: showSourceCode
methods.description: Displays source code with line highlighting for error context.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Checks if an attachment exists for a page.

methods.name: putAttachment
methods.description: Uploads or updates an attachment for a page.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of an attachment, either from file or string content.

methods.name: uploadAttachment
methods.description: Uploads an attachment if not already present or if size differs.
